title: Carousel Studio post spec
description: spec.json: the Studio's input. Skills fill it; validate.py --checkpoint checks completeness.

rev.description: Incremented by every writer (Studio save, Claude patch).

metaLabel.description: Text of the header meta slot (series or topic label); empty = slot omitted.

compat.description: Switches that disable a broken paint or encode path without a runtime release.

clip.description: Local footage in the cover media window. Trim points are seconds; out must exceed in and stay inside the clip duration (checked when decoding).

ending.description: Dissolve only when endpoints resemble each other; otherwise a wipe returns to the poster.

logo.description: Optional creator-supplied product or partner mark on the cover. Never bundled; the creator is responsible for usage rights. Fixed style position and size; contain fit, never mirrored.

ground.description: Solid light (default) or dark ground; supply the matching logo artwork.

lines.description: Element key (s03.title) -> physical lines after fit, in reading order; words separated by one space (U+00A0 bindings kept).

sizes.description: Element key -> fitted font size in px at the approved layout.

marks.description: slide id -> the text-bound marks the settle pass placed (rounded to 0.5 px), reused by every later paint.

anchors.description: slide id -> the anchor box the approved layout was fitted with.

ext.description: Reserved extension namespace. Tools may store private data here; engines ignore it.

ref.description: Embedded data URI or opaque host asset id; up to 2,000,000 characters (about 1.5 MB binary). The cap bounds page memory and portable post size, not image quality or file-system access.

preset.description: ig-3x4 = 1080x1440 (default). ig-4x5 = 1080x1350, a safety flag only: SP6 passed, so 3:4 stays the canvas of video-first carousels.

hash16.description: FNV-1a 64-bit of canonical JSON, 16 lowercase hex digits (see CONTRACT section 3.2).

hookFamily.description: Family code: P1-P16 playbook, F17-F23 new, S1-S3 soft-sell.

cover.description: Compressed cover text actually used on slide 1.

id.description: Long stable identifier (brand, spec, plan, occasion pack).

value.description: Western digits, '.' decimal. Converted to locale.digits at render time.

overrides.description: Dotted token path -> value, e.g. {'roles.accent': '#E3262B'}. Applied by CS.core.resolve.

el.description: Element key, e.g. s03.title or s03.bullets.2 or caption.firstLine.

qaResult.description: One QA finding. Identical shape in spec.qa.results and qa-report.results.

shortId.description: Short local identifier (source, asset, prompt, angle, pillar, slot).

id.description: Stable identity: s01, s02, ... two-digit ids, never reused after deletion.

headline.description: Hero text (cover, rehook, share, poster). '==x==' marks the emphasis span; '\n' is a forced line break.

sides.description: compare / myth-fact: [first, second] in logical order (myth then fact; A then B).

ord.description: Item / step ordinal. Engine derives it when absent.

kashidaWord.description: Exact headline word to stretch. At most one per post and only where the preset allows.

notes.description: Author note, never rendered or exported.

free.description: Free design lane (data/free-design.json): HTML and scoped CSS the Art Director writes by hand; any slide type except cover. validate.py checks the content, the cover rule and the byte limits; maxLength here counts code points

swipeCue.description: arrow-rtl = 'اسحب ←' (Arabic-UI audiences); arrow-ltr = 'اسحب →'; neutral = the counter and a quiet progress rail, no arrow.
